events.description: Before the popover closes. Call `preventDefault()` to keep it open.
events.name: ok:popover:beforeclose

events.description: Before the popover opens. Call `preventDefault()` to keep it closed.
events.name: ok:popover:beforeopen

events.description: After the popover closed, with what closed it.
events.name: ok:popover:close

events.description: After the popover opened next to `anchor`.
events.name: ok:popover:open

methods.description: Opens next to `anchor`: an element or a virtual anchor (`getBoundingClientRect()`, such as a text selection). Returns `false` if `ok:popover:beforeopen` was prevented.
methods.name: open

methods.description: Opens the popover next to `anchor` when it is closed, and closes it otherwise.
methods.name: toggle

options.description: Side of the anchor and alignment; flips to the other side when there is no room.
options.name: placement

options.description: Draws an arrow pointing at the anchor.
options.name: arrow

options.description: Focus stays on the anchor when it opens (hover popovers).
options.name: disableAutoFocus

options.description: Focus isn't moved back to the anchor on close.
options.name: disableRestoreFocus

options.description: What positions it: `anchorEl` (the anchor), `anchorPosition` (a point, `anchorPosition` / `data-ok-anchor-position`) or `none` (your CSS).
options.name: anchorReference

options.description: Minimum distance to the viewport edges (px).
options.name: marginThreshold

options.description: Length of the opening animation (ms). Default: the theme's shorter duration.
options.name: transitionDuration

options.description: Open state (`open` + `anchorEl` / `onOpenChange`; HTML: a trigger or `open()`).
options.name: open

parts.description: The point the popover opens at with `data-ok-anchor-reference="anchorPosition"`: `top,left` in px from the viewport's top left corner.
parts.name: data-ok-anchor-position

parts.description: Set by the runtime: the side the popover opened on after flipping.
parts.name: data-ok-current-placement

parts.description: Set by the runtime when the browser lacks the Popover API.
parts.name: data-ok-fallback

parts.description: The arrow that points at the anchor (shown with `data-ok-arrow`).
parts.name: data-ok-popover-arrow

parts.description: Opens the popover whose `id` it names while the pointer hovers the element.
parts.name: data-ok-popover-hover

parts.description: Opens the popover whose `id` it names next to the element.
parts.name: data-ok-popover-open

react.description: A `div[popover=manual]` in the top layer, positioned next to `anchorEl` by the core popover controller. Controlled, like MUI: keep `open` in state and set it from `onOpenChange`.

props.description: The element the popover points at.
props.name: anchorEl

props.description: The point, in px from the viewport's top left corner, used with `anchorReference="anchorPosition"`.
props.name: anchorPosition

props.description: What positions the popover: `"anchorEl"` (default), `"anchorPosition"` (the point in `anchorPosition`; `anchorEl` may then be left out) or `"none"` (your own CSS).
props.name: anchorReference

props.description: Draws an arrow pointing at the anchor.
props.name: arrow

props.description: Focus stays on the anchor when the popover opens (hover popovers).
props.name: disableAutoFocus

props.description: Focus isn't moved back to the anchor on close.
props.name: disableRestoreFocus

props.description: Where focus goes on open; default: the first focusable element, else the popover.
props.name: initialFocus

props.description: Minimum distance to the viewport edges, in px. Default 16.
props.name: marginThreshold

props.description: Called when the user asks to close: `"escape"` or `"backdrop"` (a press outside).
props.name: onOpenChange

props.description: Side of the anchor and alignment. Flips when there is no room.
props.name: placement

props.description: Length of the opening animation, in ms. Default: the theme's shorter duration.
props.name: transitionDuration
